newsitem.title: UK: Reuters buys mutual funds information firm.
newsitem.headline: Reuters buys mutual funds information firm.

text.p: International news and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it had bought Hardwick Stafford Wright Ltd (HSW), a British-based mutual funds information company.

It said in a statement the value of the net assets being acquired was less than one million stg and that the total consideration paid by Reuters in cash and loan notes was not material in the context of Reuters net assets.

HSW, formed in 1986, is a supplier of funds information to the mutual fund industry in Britain. It has 18 employees and around 250 customers consisting of large fund managers, pension fund managers and independent financial advisers.
